title: C.E.L.L. Editor
description: A visual editor for C.E.L.L. was necessary to increase productivity for the game designers using it. The editor focuses on level and menu design, as well as key binding, collision, events, and scripting. This editor has been used for a variety of games and prototypes, including RPGs, platformers, infinite runners, side-scrolling shooters, puzzle games, and strategy games.
